novel_features.name: Court-day check
novel_features.description: Answer yes/no for whether a date is an LASC court day, with the reason.
novel_features.rationale: Joins weekend rules with the court's own synced holiday list; the web page cannot answer it.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Reach for this before setting a hearing or filing date.

novel_features.name: Add court days
novel_features.description: Count N court days forward or backward from a date, skipping weekends and LASC holidays.
novel_features.rationale: Date arithmetic over the court's published holidays, which the page does not offer.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use for any court-day deadline instead of counting by hand.

novel_features.name: Next holiday
novel_features.description: Show the next LASC court holiday and how many days away it is.
novel_features.rationale: Cross-year lookup relative to today over the cached holiday list.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Quick answer to 'when is the court closed next?'.

novel_features.name: Calendar-day deadline with roll-forward
novel_features.description: Add N calendar days and roll a weekend or holiday end date to the next court day.
novel_features.rationale: CCP 12a-style roll-forward needs LASC holiday awareness.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use for calendar-day periods; use add-court-days for court-day periods.

novel_features.name: Court days between
novel_features.description: Count court days between two dates and list the holidays in the span.
novel_features.rationale: Counts weekdays minus LASC holidays across years from the local store.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Check whether there is still time before a hearing.

novel_features.name: ICS export
novel_features.description: Export LASC holidays as calendar files, for one year or every published year.
novel_features.rationale: The court page has no export; this produces RFC 5545 files from the published list.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Import every upcoming court holiday onto your own calendar or device.

narrative.headline: LA Superior Court judicial holidays plus court-day deadline math and calendar export, from the court's own published list.
narrative.value_prop: Lists the Superior Court of Los Angeles County's judicial holidays straight from the court's site, caches them offline, and answers the questions the page can't: is-court-day, add-court-days, deadline roll-forward, court-days-between, next-holiday. ics exports every published year as calendar files.

quickstart.comment: Confirm the CLI is installed and configured
See the next day the court is closed
Count 16 court days from a date
Write one .ics per published year for your calendar

troubleshoots.fix: The court publishes 2006 through about five years ahead (2030 today); run lacourt-holidays-pp-cli holidays --year <year> to check a year
Add --no-cache to bypass the local response cache and fetch the court's current list

narrative.when_to_use: Use this CLI to check LASC court holidays, decide whether a date is a court day, or compute court-day and calendar-day deadlines for Los Angeles Superior Court matters. It also exports the holidays as ICS calendar files.
anti_triggers: Do not use it for other courts' holidays (federal courts, other counties)
Do not use it to look up statutory notice periods; it only does the date arithmetic you give it
Not legal advice; confirm critical deadlines against the court
